svg.title: Hi, I'm Rodrigo. Senior Software Engineer and Tech Lead.
svg.desc: Hi, I’m Rodrigo. Senior Software Engineer and Tech Lead. Engineer, solopreneur and tech nerd with published projects and ten years building software. AI, Java, Node.js, Python, React, React Native, Kafka, Cloud and DevOps. I love solving problems, from architecture and data to integrations, infrastructure and delivery. I build, automate, deploy and keep systems running. Cloud, CI/CD, containers and observability included. One engineer. From first idea to production.
